C0545.title: Beijing 'Return Sister' Shi Detained for Malicious Clothing Swap Scam
C0545.summary: A Beijing woman surnamed Shi was criminally detained for fraud after using multiple accounts and vacant property addresses to order new clothes, then returning old or soiled garments for refunds. In one instance, she swapped over 90 items, involving more than 20,000 yuan.

references.title: Beijing 'Return Sister' Detained: Maliciously Swapped and Returned Items for Refunds Over 4 Years, Once Swapped Over 90 Items at Once
